doc.title: Frank Foster interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 7, 1998

title: Closing thanks
summary: Rowe thanks Foster and they go to dinner.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Go play with that white guy that can’t play. Well this has really been a great pleasure for me, and I want to thank you for sharing your sentiments, and you’re very well spoken about your opinions. And I want to thank you for all the great music over the years, and it’s a pleasure to have you on the campus.
